actualWorkFindings.finding: Conversion and Christian conscience; four divisions require Scripture immersion, fellowship and self-examination; fallibility rejects subjective moral infallibility.
Two physical/spiritual categories, three resources and gentle posture. Gospel/Scripture/Christian fellowship are substantial reasoning, not isolated advice or political position.
Schooling case distinguishes private/pulpit pastoral reasoning; neither coerces beyond biblical warrant nor treats moral freedom as ethical neutrality.

Redemption and reasons for obedience, chapter16 Work and chapters17-19 motives/norms/situations supply gospel-centered ethics; Politics and two-kingdom debate remain attributed and outside selected daily-ethics paths.

Eleven bylined articles from seven distinct historical authors; conscience corrupted by sin, gospel peace, not ritual soothing. Working 1689 anchor does not erase Anglican/Presbyterian polity or universal-atonement phrasing.

Six bylined pieces. Wilson actually bases Eph4-5 rejection of bitterness on Christ cross; no family-wide or Federal Vision approval inferred. Adams/MacArthur repentance/reconciliation conditions remain distinct from charitable posture; not merged into one policy.
Nine historical articles from seven authors frame works as effects/evidences of saving grace rather than grounds of justification; nested quotes and compiler notes retain voices.
